```python
def transform(grid):
    # swap: background takes the accent color, accent cells become 0
    vals = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # background is the majority color
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    other = [v for v in vals if v != bg][0]
    return [[0 if v == other else other for v in row] for row in grid]
```
